description: An Angular component for displaying daily nutritional summaries, which updates when the input date changes and fetches data via ApiService.

classes.name: DailySummaryComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays a summarized view of nutrition data for a specific date, updating on input changes.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that triggers when input properties change; calls load() when the 'date' input updates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches daily summary data for the selected date using ApiService and updates the component state.
